title: Jacob and his family go down to Egypt (AM 2298)
summary: Jacob, aged 130, goes down to Egypt with his family of seventy in the second year of the famine (Gen 45:6; 46; 47:9).
description: God told Jacob at Beersheba not to fear going down to Egypt (Gen 46:1-4). Pharaoh settled the family in Goshen. Jones and Jordan both note this is exactly 215 years after Abraham entered Canaan, and 215 before the Exodus.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones baseline): 1706 BC (no higher-tier year available).
